ЦБСТ and РОЙ.МАРКЕТ a Moscow non-profit, its military marketplace, and the drone-war supply around it

An open-source investigation of АНО «ЦБСТ», a Moscow non-profit for the drone industry, and of the companies, products, sales and handovers to military units that connect to it. Every claim rests on an archived document and is graded by how well that document shows it.

Original Russian«ЦБСТ вместе с Единой Россией и фондом «Наша правда» поставили на фронт тысячи изделий для уничтожения врага. […] Вместе с партией и ПСБ запустили военный маркетплейс «Роймаркет». Платформа протестирована.» Александр Сидякин, secretary of ЦБСТ's supervisory board and head of United Russia's central executive committee, on ЦБСТ's year, Telegram, 15.12.20251 "ЦБСТ together with United Russia and the «Наша правда» foundation delivered thousands of items to the front for destroying the enemy. […] Together with the party and ПСБ we launched the military marketplace Roymarket. The platform has been tested."

The network on file

The investigation's registry links 73 organisations to ЦБСТ: 60 through a document (a register entry, a contract, ЦБСТ's own posts), 13 on their own word or press reports alone. 35 of them are on at least one sanctions list. Counted from the registry on 02.10.2026.

How to read the evidence

  • Documented A primary document shows it: a register extract, a contract, an annual filing, a post by the party itself.
  • Reported One party's own word, or the press. Donors' handover posts are graded here until a second source confirms them.
  • Not documented The link must exist, but no document on file shows it.

Red marks only a sanctions listing, and always names the regimes. Names appear as registered, in Russian; a company known by its brand is shown by the brand, with the registered name beneath it.

How this is made

  • Facts come from the original Russian documents, read in full: company register extracts, annual accounts, procurement records, trademark records, court filings and the parties' own Telegram posts and websites. Summaries and machine translations are leads, never sources.
  • Every document is archived and hashed when it is collected. Each note at the end of a page says what the document is and links to it where a public copy exists.
  • Pictures are evidence only for what they show, and each says who published it. Faces of people taking part are shown; nobody is named from a face.

What this does not show

  • A handover to a unit does not show that the equipment was used in combat. Some recipients are rear units.
  • ЦБСТ's share in the company that runs РОЙ.МАРКЕТ is not stated in any document on file, and since 15.07.2026 the company register withholds who owns that company12.
  • A US sanctions entry under a similar name belongs to a different company registered in Tula. ЦБСТ itself is not shown here as sanctioned by the US.
  • This is a draft. The earlier case studies and company profiles were withdrawn while the site is rebuilt around chain views.
